F:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ah, Walhart...
C'est donc ici que vous vous cachiez ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Je souhaitais vous demander conseil.
Je ne vous dérange pas, j'espère ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|L'obséquiosité ne te va pas. Je te rappelle
que tu es ma supérieure dans cette armée.$k$pAlors, explique-toi, stratège. En quoi
puis-je t'assister ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Comme vous le savez, nous allons au devant
de rudes batailles.$k$pIl faut donc nous y préparer au mieux.$k$pQuelle stratégie mettriez-vous en œuvre
si vous étiez à ma place ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Je n'ai pas de conseils à te donner.$k$pLes plans de bataille ne m'ont jamais été
d'une grande utilité.$k$pIl n'y a pas grand-chose à tirer des
complots et des manigances des stratèges.$k$pLa victoire d'une armée repose sur
le courage et la ferveur de ses soldats.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Vous ignoriez donc purement et simplement
la stratégie... ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|J'étais le Conquérant ! Le maître de tous
les hommes, régnant d'un littoral à l'autre !$k$pJe ne méprise pas cette stratégie qui t'es
chère. Mais je n'en avais nul besoin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|Tout se décidait sur le champ de bataille ?
D'homme à homme, d'épée à épée ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Oui. Mais visiblement, ma méthode n'était
pas la bonne.$k$pCar c'est moi qui maintenant suis ici votre
serviteur, moi qui suis avili à jamais...$k$pJe suis à jamais couvert de l'ignominie et de
la honte provoquées par la défaite.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Même si nos points de vue divergent,
il n'y a pas de honte à perdre une guerre.$k$pVous avez combattu avec bravoure.
Votre défaite n'a en rien terni votre image.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|Sotte ! Bien sûr que si ! Tous me croient
faible, et en vérité, ils n'ont pas tort.$k$pUn homme qui exige le respect par la force
de l'épée le perd lorsque celle-ci se brise.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Walhart, vous avez perdu une seule bataille.
Cela ne fait pas de vous un homme faible.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|Pour moi, si. Mais je sais que Chrom pense
différemment, et c'est lui le vainqueur.$k$pLes vaincus n'ont pas droit à leurs propres
convictions ; ils doivent suivre leur maître.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Il est enrichissant de pouvoir compter
sur diverses opinions.$k$pMême sans les partager, s'initier à de
nouvelles idées nous rend plus forts.$k$pPromettez-moi de ne pas abandonner les
vôtres. Vous avez beaucoup à m'apprendre.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_4|Ta curiosité me rappelle celle d'un enfant
ayant capturé un insecte fascinant.$k$pQu'importe. Je céderai à ton caprice.
Peut-être que cela aidera à passer le temps.$k
$Sbs2000|
G:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ah, Walhart. Hier habt Ihr Euch also
versteckt.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Ich hatte gehofft, Euch um Euren Rat bitten
zu dürfen. Habt Ihr gerade Zeit?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Du bittest mich? Vergiss nicht, dass du in
dieser Armee ranghöher bist als ich.$k$pUnd jetzt trage deine Bitte vor, Taktikerin.
Wobei suchst du Rat?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Wie Ihr wisst, stehen uns einige schwere
Kämpfe bevor.$k$pDaher frage ich mich, wie Eure Strategie
aussähe, wenn Ihr unser Anführer wärt.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Bei dieser Sache kann ich dir nicht helfen.$k$pIch benötigte keine Schlachtpläne.$k$pIch hatte keinen Bedarf an den listigen
Tricks eines Taktikers.$k$pIch gewann Kriege dank des Mutes meiner
Soldaten und der Stärke ihres Glaubens.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ihr lehntet Strategie also ganz und gar ab?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|Ich war der Eroberer! Herr aller Menschen
und Herrscher über einen ganzen Kontinent!$k$pIch verabscheute deine Strategien nicht.
Ich hatte für sie einfach keinen Bedarf.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|Also wurde alles auf dem Schlachtfeld
entschieden? Mann gegen Mann?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Ja. Aber meine Methode war offensichtlich
die falsche, denn nun diene ich unter dir.$k$pIch bin es, der für immer mit der Schmach
und Schande jener Niederlage leben muss.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Wir stellen zwar Eure Motive in Frage, doch
einen Krieg zu verlieren ist keine Schande.$k$pIhr habt herausragend und tapfer gekämpft
und niemand zweifelt an Euren Fähigkeiten.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|Närrin! Natürlich tun sie das! Sie halten
mich alle für schwach und sie haben Recht!$k$pEin Mann, der mit dem Schwert Respekt
einfordert, verliert alles, wenn es zerbricht.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Walhart, Ihr verlort eine einzige Schlacht.
Das macht Euch noch lange nicht schwach.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|In meiner Welt schon. Aber ich weiß, dass
Chrom anders denkt, und er ist der Sieger.$k$pDer Besiegte hat kein Anrecht auf seine
eigene Überzeugung. Er muss Folge leisten.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Aber es ist gut, dass Ihr Euren eigenen
Glauben und Eure eigenen Methoden habt.$k$pSelbst, wenn wir nicht einer Meinung sind.
Andere Werte und Ideen bereichern uns.$k$pVersprecht mir, Eure eigenen
Überzeugungen nicht aufzugeben!$k$pIch könnte von Euch und Euren Methoden
bestimmt noch etwas lernen.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_4|Deine Neugierde ähnelt der eines Kindes,
das ein interessantes Insekt gefangen hat.$k$pDoch ganz gleich. Ich werde deiner Laune
Genüge tun... Als Zeitvertreib.$k
$Sbs2000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ah, Walhart. Ecco dove vi nascondevate.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Volevo chiedervi un consiglio.
È un buon momento per voi?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|L'ossequiosità è fuori luogo. Ti ricordo che
in questo esercito sei un mio superiore.$k$pAdesso bando alle ciance, parla, stratega.
Che genere di suggerimenti stavi cercando?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Come sapete, ci attendono delle
battaglie piuttosto impegnative.$k$pEcco, mi chiedevo quale sarebbe la vostra
strategia, nel caso foste voi al comando.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|In questo non posso aiutarti.$k$pNon ho bisogno di schemi e strategie.$k$pNon mi servono i raggiri e
le astuzie degli strateghi.$k$pIo vinco le battaglie con la tempra dei miei
soldati e il coraggio dei miei ideali.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Quindi rifiutate ogni supporto strategico?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|Io ero il Conquistatore! Padrone di tutti gli
uomini, regnante da una costa all'altra!$k$pNon disdegno le tue strategie.
Semplicemente non ne ho bisogno!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|Allora tutto era deciso in battaglia? Con la
sola forza dell'acciaio, da uomo a uomo?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Sì, ma la mia è stata una scelta perdente,
dato che ora sono io a servire voi.$k$pSono io che ho subito l'onta
e il disonore della sconfitta.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Anche se non condivido le vostre ragioni,
non c'è disonore nel perdere in battaglia.$k$pAvete combattuto con coraggio e abilità.
Nessuno vi disdegna perché foste sconfitto.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|Sciocca! Mi disprezzano, eccome! Tutti
mi reputano un debole e hanno ragione.$k$pSe un uomo esige rispetto con la forza della
spada, lo perde del tutto se viene sconfitto.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Walhart, avete perso una sola battaglia.
Ciò non vi rende un debole.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|Nel mio mondo, sì. Ma so che Chrom la
pensa diversamente e lui è il vincitore.$k$pGli sconfitti non possono seguire le proprie
convinzioni, seguono i loro padroni.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Ma è utile che voi abbiate convinzioni
e modi di fare personali.$k$pAnche se non le condividiamo,
conoscere le idee degli altri ci rafforza.$k$pNon rinunciate alle vostre idee!
Potrei imparare qualcosa da voi.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_4|La tua è la curiosità del bambino che
ha catturato un insetto esotico.$k$pMa che importa ormai? Asseconderò il tuo
capriccio. E forse ne trarrò giovamento.$k
$Sbs2000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|¡Ajá! Así que estabais aquí
escondido, ¿eh, Walhart?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|(...)$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Venía a pediros consejo.
¿Os cojo en mal momento?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Arrastrarse no me parece muy
propio de un superior.$k$pRecuerda que, en este ejército, tú
das las órdenes y yo las recibo.$k$pY ahora dime, estratega: ¿qué clase de
consejo andas buscando?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Como sabéis, nos aguardan algunas batallas
muy duras.$k$pY quería saber qué tipo de estrategia
seguiríais vos si estuvierais al mando.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Me temo que no puedo ayudarte.$k$pMis soldados y mis generales no precisaban
de planes ni de complots para luchar.$k$pNosotros no recurríamos jamás a las
artimañas engañosas de los estrategas.$k$pGanábamos las guerras con el temple de
nuestras espadas y la fuerza de nuestra fe.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|De modo que siempre habéis rechazado
de plano el uso de la estrategia, ¿eh?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|¡Yo era el Conquistador, amo y
señor de todos los hombres!$k$p¡Mis dominios se extendían hasta
los confines de este planeta!$k$pNo es que desdeñara esas estrategias
tuyas; simplemente, no las necesitaba.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|O sea que todo se decidía cuerpo a cuerpo
en el campo de batalla, ¿no?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Exacto, pero es evidente que me equivoqué.
De lo contrario, ahora no sería tu vasallo.$k$pTendré que cargar de por vida con
la ignominia de la derrota.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Aunque cuestionemos vuestros motivos,
perder una guerra no es nada ignominioso.$k$pPeleasteis con valentía, así que la opinión
que se tiene sobre vos no ha empeorado.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|¡Mentira! Ahora todos me ven débil,
y lo cierto es que tienen razón.$k$pA quien infunde respeto a golpe de espada
no le queda nada cuando cae derrotado.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Vos perdisteis solamente una batalla. Dudo
que eso os convierta en alguien débil.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|En mi mundo, sí, mas sé que Chrom tiene
otro criterio, y él es quien me venció.$k$pQuien ha sido derrotado no tiene derecho a
opinar, sino solo a seguir a su líder.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Pero para nosotros es bueno que poseáis
vuestra opinión y forma de proceder.$k$pY aunque yo las ponga en entredicho, se
puede aprender de las ideas de los demás.$k$pPrometedme que no vais a abandonar
las vuestras. Seguro que aprendo de vos.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_4|Tu curiosidad es pueril, como la de un niño
que ha cazado un insecto raro.$k$pPero no importa; te daré el capricho.
Quizá sea un buen pasatiempo.$k
$Sbs2000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ah, Walhart. So this is where
you've been hiding.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|I was actually hoping to ask for
your advice. Is now a good time?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Grovelling ill suits you. Remember that
you are my superior in this army.$k$pNow state your business, tactician.
What advice do you seek?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|We're expecting tough battles
ahead, as you know.$k$pSo I was wondering what your approach
would be if you were in charge.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|I cannot help you in this.$k$pI had little need for battle plans and plots.$k$pLittle need for the cunning trickery of the
tactician...$k$pI won battles on the mettle of my soldiers
and the strength of our beliefs.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|So you rejected strategy entirely?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|I was the Conqueror! Master of all men.
My domain stretched from sea to sea!$k$pI held no disdain for your strategy.
I simply had no need of it.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|So all was decided on the battlefield?
Man to man and steel to steel?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Yes. But clearly mine was the wrong way.
For it is I who stand here as your servant―$k$pI who am tarred forever with the ignominy
and shame of ultimate defeat.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Though we question your motives,
there is no shame in losing a war.$k$pYou fought bravely and well.
Nobody thinks less of you in defeat.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|Fool! Of course they do! They think
me weak, and they are correct.$k$pIf a man demands respect at the end of
a sword, he has none left when it shatters.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Walhart, you lost a single battle.
That hardly makes you weak.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|It does in my world. But I know that Chrom
believes differently, and he is the victor.$k$pThe vanquished have no right to their own
convictions―they must follow their masters.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|But it's a healthy thing to have a mix of
different beliefs, new ways of doing things...$k$pEven if we don't agree with them, learning
about other ideas only makes us stronger.$k$pYou must promise not to forsake your views.
I could learn something from your ways.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_4|You speak as a child that has captured
a particularly interesting insect...$k$pBut no matter. I shall indulge your whim.
There are worse ways to pass the time.$k
$Sbs2000|

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Ah, Walhart. Demek
saklandigin yer burası.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Aslında tavsiyeni almayı
umuyordum. Şimdi iyi bir zaman mı?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Yere kapanmak sana hiç yakışmıyor. Bu
orduda benim üstüm olduğunu unutma.$k$pŞimdi işini anlat taktikçi. Ne
tavsiyesi istiyorsun?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Bildiğiniz gibi önümüzde zorlu
mücadeleler bekliyoruz.$k$pBu yüzden, eğer sorumlu olsaydiniz
yaklaşiminiz ne olurdu diye merak
ediyordum.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Bu konuda sana yardımcı olamam.$k$pSavaş planlarina ve komplolarina pek
ihtiyacım yoktu.$k$pTaktisyenin kurnaz hilelerine pek
gerek yok...$k$pSavaşlari askerlerimin cesareti ve
inançlarimizin gücüyle kazandım.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Yani stratejiyi tamamen mi reddettin?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|Ben Fatihtim! Tüm erkeklerin efendisi.
Etki alanim denizden denize uzanıyordu!$k$pStratejinizi küçümsemedim.
Buna hiç ihtiyacım yoktu.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_23|Yani her şey savaş alanında mı
kararlastirildi? Erkek erkeğe ve çelikten
çelige?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Evet. Ama açıkça benimki yanlış yoldu.
Çünkü burada hizmetkariniz olarak duran
benim.$k$pNihai yenilginin rezilligi ve utanciyla
sonsuza kadar katranlanmis olan ben.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_8|Niyetlerinizi sorgulasak da savaşı
kaybetmenin utanılacak bir yani yok.$k$pCesurca ve iyi savaştin.
Yenilgide kimse seni daha az düşünmez.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_11|Aptal! Elbette yapıyorlar! Zayıf
olduğumu düşünüyorlar ve haklılar.$k$pBir adam kılıcın ucuyla saygı
isterse, kirildiginda saygisi kalmaz.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Walhart, tek bir savaşı
kaybettin. Bu seni pek zayıf yapmaz.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_21|Benim dünyamda öyle. Ancak Chrom'un farklı
inandığını ve kazananın o olduğunu
biliyorum.$k$pYenilenlerin kendi inançlarina sahip olma
hakları yoktur; efendilerinin peşinden
gitmeleri gerekir.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Ancak farklı inançlarin ve yeni iş yapma
yöntemlerinin bir karışimina sahip olmak
sağlıklı bir şey...$k$pOnlarla aynı fikirde olmasak bile, başka
fikirleri öğrenmek bizi yalnızca daha

$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|It's time I sorted my old tomes, so I've
unpacked the entire library.$k$pI didn't realise how many books I've
collected! Goodness me.$k$p$E苦,|Maybe I...shouldn't have...picked up so
many... S-starting to...lose...balance!$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_14|...Idiocy. Here.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Walhart? What are you doing?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|You were struggling under the load.
I decided to assist.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_31|Riiight. But you're holding me,
not the books...?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_15|It seemed the quickest way to help.
But if it displeases you...$k$p...There. Safely on your
own two feet again.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|*cough* Er, thank you.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_12|Why do you carry your own tomes?$k$pSurely such menial work could be assigned
to the grunts. Or prisoners of war.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|We do NOT enslave prisoners of war in
this army, Walhart!$k$pAnd for that matter, we don't refer to any
of our soldiers as "grunts".$k$pEveryone is on equal terms here.
Menial tasks are shared by all.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_3|Why am I not surprised at such a sickening
display of misguided democracy?$k$pVery well, then. ORDER me to carry
your books.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Er...I don't think I'm comfortable with that.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|You are an army of equals, yes?
Menial tasks are shared by all?$k$pThen even the great Walhart should
not be above such things!$k$pOr do you just pay lip service to "equality"
while the hierarchy is alive and well?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|Fine. You win... Walhart, I order you
to carry my books.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_20|Gladly... Hmm? This trunk is
hardly heavy at all!$k$pBah. The tactician who brought down my
army has the strength of a mewling kitten!$k$p'Tis amusing to think such a brilliant
warmonger can barely lift a box of papers.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_15|It wasn't me who brought you down.
It was the combined strength of our army.$k$pMeasured one against one, I'd barely come
up to your ankle... Figuratively speaking.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_23|Yet you have the power to marshal the
collective strength of your fellow men.$k$p$E笑,|The people of this world could do far worse
than to have you as supreme ruler.$k$pI wager you could bring the prosperity
and peace they've long yearned for.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|I didn't realise you cared so much
about the lives of the smallfolk.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_6|It was my methods that were wrong,
not my motives.$k$p...It all fell apart once I began to worship
might for its own sake.$k$pThat wicked Grimleal fanatic whispering
lies in my ear didn't help matters...$k$pThe responsibility was all mine,
but I can't help but think...$k$pWhat if I'd met you instead of Excellus?
Perhaps I'd have seen the error of my ways.$k$pPerhaps I'd have become the benevolent
monarch I first set out to be...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_21|It's not too late. You still have the power to
put things right. To improve the lives of all.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|I can scarce believe such folly.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Remember what I told you before?$k$pWhere there's life, there's a will. And where
there's will, there is the power to change.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|...Very well.$k$pAs you have spoken truth to me before,
I shall trust you and your words.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|It's all true.
You'll see...$k

$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_9|*öksürük* Şey, teşekkür ederim.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_12|Büyü kitaplarını neden kendin

sergilenmesine neden şaşırmadim?$k$pPeki öyleyse. Kitaplarinizi tasimami

$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Ee...bu konuda rahat olduğumu sanmıyorum.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_13|Siz esitlerden oluşan bir ordusunuz, değil

$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_14|İyi. Sen kazandın... Walhart, sana

$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_20|Memnuniyetle... Hımm? Bu sandık

bir kutu kagidi zorlukla kaldirabileceğini
düşünmek çok eğlenceli.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_15|Seni aşağıya çeken ben
değildim. Ordumuzun birlesik gücüydü.$k$pBire bir ölçtüm, zar zor ayak bileginize
kadar gelebiliyordum... Mecazi anlamda
konuşursak.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_23|Yine de dostlarinizin kolektif
gücünü harekete geçirme gücüne sahipsiniz.$k$p$E笑|Bu dünyanın insanları, senin yüce hükümdar
olmandan çok daha kötüsünü yapabilirler.$k$pUzun zamandır özlemini duydukları refahi

$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Halkın hayatını bu kadar
önemsedigini bilmiyordum.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_6|Yanlış olan güdülerim değil,
yöntemlerimdi.$k$p...Kendi iyiliği için güce tapmaya
başladigimda her şey dağıldı.$k$pO kötü Grimleal fanatiginin kulağıma
yalanlar fisildamasi hiçbir ise
yaramadı...$k$pBütün sorumluluk bana aitti
ama düşünmeden edemiyorum...$k$pYa Excellus yerine seninle tanışsaydim?
Belki de yolumun hatasini görmüş olurdum.$k$pBelki de ilk başta olmak istediğim
hayırsever hükümdar olurdum...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_21|Çok geç değil. Hâlâ işleri düzeltecek güce
sahipsin. Herkesin hayatını iyileştirmek.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|Böyle bir aptalliga inanamıyorum.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Sana daha önce ne söylediğimi hatırlıyor
musun?$k$pYaşamin olduğu yerde irade de vardır. Ve
iradenin olduğu yerde, değişme gücü de
vardır.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|...Çok iyi.$k$pDaha önce bana doğruyu söylediğin

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|Ah, te voilà.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Walhart. Que puis-je faire pour vous ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|À propos de ce que tu m'as dit... Sur la vie,
la volonté, la capacité de changer...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_13|Je vous écoute...$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|J'ai réfléchi à ce que je pourrais changer.
À ce que je DEVRAIS changer.$k
$Wsusername|$WaContinuez.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_15|Depuis que Chrom et toi m'avez battu, j'ai
appris beaucoup de choses.$k$pAu sujet de la vision qu'Emmeryn avait du
monde, par exemple.$k$pJe souhaite ardemment que celle-ci
devienne réalité.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_21|Vous... ? Je suis très surprise.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Je ne sais pas si c'est là le changement
dont tu parlais.$k$pMais je sais maintenant quelle est
ma mission.$k$pJe vais m'atteler à bâtir un avenir où
le rêve d'Emmeryn est une réalité.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Eh bien je trouve cela merveilleux, Walhart !$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_28|Dans ce cas, je sais que c'est la bonne
décision.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Vous qui paraissiez si intimidant, vous qui
transpiriez la haine...$k$pAujourd'hui, vous êtes méconnaissable.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|Je suppose que c'est l'impression que j'ai
pu donner, en effet.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Sous vos airs menaçants, vous deviez avoir
quelque chose comme... un cœur tendre.$k$pQuand bien même vous aviez choisi la voie
de la conquête et de l'asservissement...$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Je voulais unifier le monde sous mon règne
pour promouvoir la paix et le bien-être.$k$pJe me suis trompé de chemin... Celui-là ne
menait qu'à la destruction et au désespoir.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Alors recommencez à zéro. Tirez parti de
votre expérience pour changer les choses.$k$pVotre but reste inchangé. Vous avez besoin
uniquement d'une nouvelle voie à suivre.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_15|Là où il y a de la vie, il y a de la volonté.
Et là où il y a de la volonté...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Tout à fait !$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|J'aimerais t'avoir à mes côtés pour que tu
me donnes la force de suivre ce chemin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Vous... Vous voulez dire en tant
que stratège ?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_6|Non. En tant que partenaire...
En tant qu'épouse.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Moi, votre ÉPOUSE ?!$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_23|Qui d'autre ? Tu dois me guider sur cette
nouvelle voie, ou je m'égarerai encore.$k$p$E通常,照|Avec le temps, je me suis... fortement
attaché à toi.$k
$Wsusername|$WaOh.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Tu n'es pas obligée de me répondre tout de
suite, si tu préfères y réfléchir.$k$pJe suis disposé à attendre aussi longtemps
qu'il sera nécessaire.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|En réalité, je n'ai pas besoin d'y réfléchir.
Nous pouvons parcourir ce chemin à deux...$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_27|En ce cas nous bâtirons un meilleur avenir
pour ce monde !$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmヴァルハルト|7$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|Ah, hier bist du.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Walhart. Was gibt es denn?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Was du letztens gesagt hast... Leben und

$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Ich habe überlegt, wie ich mich ändern

$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_15|Seit Chrom und du mich besiegt haben,

$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_21|Das ist... sehr überraschend.$k

$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Das ist wundervoll, Walhart!

$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_28|Dann weiß ich jetzt, dass es die richtige
Entscheidung ist.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Wisst Ihr, Walhart, Ihr wart immer so
bedrohlich und zornig. Aber jetzt...$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_1|...So mag ich wohl auf den einen oder
anderen Menschen gewirkt haben.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_11|Hinter der furchterregenden Fassade
verbarg sich wohl stets ein weiches Herz.$k$p...Sogar, als Ihr zu einem Eroberungsfeldzug
der totalen Unterwerfung aufbracht.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Ich wollte die Welt unter meiner Herrschaft
vereinen und ihr so Frieden bescheren.$k$pAber ich wählte den falschen Weg, denn er
führte nur zu Zerstörung und Verzweiflung.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Dann beginnt noch einmal von vorn und
versucht es auf eine neue Art und Weise.$k$pEuer Ziel ist dasselbe. Ihr müsst bloß einem
neuen Weg folgen, um es zu erreichen.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_15|Wer lebt, der hat Willenskraft. Und wer über
Willenskraft verfügt...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Genau!$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_5|Wenn ich diesen neuen Weg beschreite,
hätte ich dich gerne an meiner Seite.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Äh, Ihr meint als Taktikerin?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_6|Nein. Als Lebensgefährtin.
...Als meine Gattin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Eure GATTIN?!?$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_23|Du und keine andere. Du musst mir helfen,
nicht von diesem neuen Weg abzukommen.$k$p$E通常,照|Und darüber hinaus habe ich dich...
lieb gewonnen.$k
$Wsusername|$WaOh.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_7|Du musst mir nicht sofort eine Antwort
geben, wenn du erst überlegen willst.$k$pIch bin bereit, so lange zu warten, wie es
nötig ist.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Äh, eigentlich muss ich gar nicht überlegen.
Wir können diesen Weg gemeinsam gehen.$k
$Wsヴァルハルト|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_WALTRUD_EVT_27|Dann werden wir eine bessere Zukunft für
alle erschaffen!$k
